==Summary==

:{{pov|[[Mat Cauthon]]}}
[[Matrim Cauthon|Mat]] stands outside the [[Tower of Ghenjei]] yelling ecstatically at it that he finally beat the [[Finn]]. [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine]] asks about the one left behind. Mat tells her that [[Noal]] died a hero and that [[Thom]] needs to write ballads informing the world about it. Mat is bitter that Thom knew about Noal's true identity.

Moiraine tells the men how the Finn fed off her emotion, although they don't need it to survive. Mat analyzes her and thinks of her as humbled and cast down, but stronger for it. Moiraine struggles to light some wet tinder, telling them that that is all she can manage now. The Finn feed on powerful emotions, but find ''[[ta'veren]]'' intoxicating. The Aelfinn and the Eelfinn took turns on feeding off Moiraine draining her ability to channel. They were fed by her sorrow at losing her ability and off the [[One Power]]. The Finn claim to have killed [[Lanfear]], but a man arrived asking about her. {{ref|Moridin came and "rescued" her, by killing her so the Dark One could reclaim her body again.}} {{Ref/book|14|p}} Moiraine asks Thom for the [[ivory bracelet]] ''[[angreal]]''. She tells the men that it was one of her three demands. Moiraine knew she would be trapped in the land of the Finn once the [[twisted redstone doorframe]] exploded leaving no way out, no matter how she worded her questions. {{ref|Moiraine knew this as it was one of her questions that she asked the Eelfinn}} {{Ref/book|4|15}} Mat inquires what else she asked for and she replies with a smile that she will keep it to herself. Moiraine asks if Mat wants Healing on his lost eye. He refuses and she wonders aloud if he is still afraid of the One Power. Moiraine then states that she needs to find [[Rand]]. Mat then tells her that he managed to clean the [[taint]] from ''[[saidin]]''. Moiraine is astonished, and smiles deeply.
:{{quote|By the Dragon came our pain, and by the Dragon was the wound repaired}} {{ref|A reference to Lews Therin’s actions causing the taint and Rand cleansing it}}
Mat tells Moiraine that Rand will be meeting with all the monarchs of the world tomorrow and that [[Elayne]] is now Queen of [[Andor]]. Moiraine asks about the [[Forsaken]] and Thom replies that the Forsaken don’t bother Mat as he is now married to the [[Seanchan]] Empress. She is surprised and but attributes it to Mat's ''[[Ta'veren|ta’veren]]'' nature. Mat is not surprised by her reply. Moiraine insists on finding Rand but Mat tells her he has other things to do. Moiraine reaches out and asks if Thom would be her husband. Thom is reluctant due to his troubles with women who could channel in the past. Moiraine offers to discard the ''angreal'' if that would change Thom's mind. Thom would never do that to her and would marry her now. Moiraine tells him that with the bracelet she will be stronger than before in the One Power. Mat is stunned and wonders how he missed the love connection between the two. Thom says that Mat wasn’t watching very closely and asks if Moiraine wants him as a [[warder]] too. Mat scorns Thom for accepting being bonded. Thom retorts that [[Tuon]] can also learn to channel. Mat watches the two as they look at each other with real love in their eyes. He walks away from the two and makes a small cairn for Noal. Mat worries about his ability to fight with only one eye. He throws his knife randomly behind him and it impales an unlucky rabbit. He then finds a cooking pot in the [[River Arinelle]] in good condition. Although distances are harder to judge, Mat’s luck more than makes up for it. He then busies himself with making dinner.
